# SEO Content Refresh Service Planner

## Purpose
Help freelancers turn an existing public page or client-authorized content export into a scoped refresh deliverable.

## Workflow
1. Confirm page ownership or client authorization and record the target audience and business objective.
2. Review the current page, query evidence supplied by the client, and official subject-matter sources.
3. Map search intent, factual gaps, outdated claims, duplication, and missing user questions.
4. Separate factual corrections from editorial recommendations and identify claims requiring expert review.
5. Draft a change plan for title, headings, structure, examples, internal links, and metadata.
6. Define acceptance criteria for factual accuracy, originality, readability, accessibility, and brand voice.
7. Specify post-publication measurement without promising rankings, traffic, or conversions.

## Output
Content diagnosis, evidence ledger, refresh outline, proposed metadata, fact-check list, and acceptance checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Do not publish, alter client CMS content, or scrape restricted content.
- Do not fabricate citations, expertise, statistics, or search-volume data.
- Use public read-only research and client-authorized material only.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Audit and drafting only.
